engine.name: Consumption
engine.does: Turns a visual or question into a DAX query.
engine.trace: Visual 'Sales by category' asks for [Net Sales] and [Gross Margin] by Product[Category].

engine.name: Query engine (DAX)
engine.does: Formula engine plans the DAX; storage engine scans compressed columns in parallel.
engine.trace: FE resolves [Gross Margin] = [Net Sales] - [Cost]; SE runs one xmSQL scan grouping Sales by Product[Category].

engine.name: Semantic engine (VertiPaq)
engine.does: Holds columns in memory, dictionary-encoded; applies relationships and security.
engine.trace: Direct Lake pages in Sales[net_amount], Sales[cost_amount], Sales[product_key] and Product[Category] on first touch (transcoding).

engine.name: Serving & SQL
engine.does: Gives SQL access to the same Delta tables; owns the load procedures for gold.
engine.trace: Not on the hot path for Direct Lake on OneLake; Direct Lake on SQL endpoint can fall back here as DirectQuery.

engine.name: Transform compute
engine.does: Builds silver and gold. Runs on a schedule, not at query time.
engine.trace: Last night's load wrote new Parquet files for fact_sales; the model was reframed after the load.

engine.name: Storage (OneLake)
engine.does: One copy of the data, open format, read by every engine above.
engine.trace: Column chunks for net_amount and product_key are read from V-Ordered Parquet files.
